note: Every fact below is extracted from a real published source and carries url + page/section + a verbatim quote. Nothing here is inferred. See docs/data-sources.md.

facts.text: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana is the government crop insurance scheme that covers notified crops against natural risks a farmer cannot prevent, from before sowing right through to after harvest.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: comprehensive risk cover for crops of farmers against all non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stage

facts.text: The aim of the scheme is to give money support to farmers whose crop is lost or damaged by events nobody could foresee.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events

facts.text: Joining the scheme is a farmer's own choice; it is optional for everyone, including farmers who have taken a crop loan or a Kisan Credit Card.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: The scheme is optional for all farmers including farmers who have been sanctioned short-term Seasonal Agricultural Operations (SAO) loans

facts.text: All crop insurance records are kept on the National Crop Insurance Portal at pmfby dot gov dot in.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Government of India has designed and developed a National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) (www.pmfby.gov.in)

facts.text: Any farmer growing a notified crop in a notified area can be covered, and that includes sharecroppers and tenant farmers.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing the notified crops in the notified areas are eligible for coverage.

facts.text: The farmer must have a real interest in the land and the crop being insured.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: farmers should have insurable interest for the insured crops and lands

facts.text: A sharecropper or tenant farmer has to show land papers such as the record of rights or a land possession certificate, or the tenancy agreement the state accepts.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: documentary evidence of land records prevailing in the State (Records of Right (RoR), Land possession Certificate (LPC) etc.)

facts.text: Every farmer joining the scheme has to give an Aadhaar number and a declaration of the crop sown or the crop they intend to sow.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: required to essentially submit Aadhar Number and declaration about the crop sown/ crops intended to be sown

facts.text: A farmer with a crop loan is covered automatically unless they gave the bank a written paper saying they do not want the insurance.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: All those farmers who do not submit the declaration would be essentially covered.

facts.text: A loanee farmer who wants to stay out must tell the bank at least seven days before the last date for joining that season.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: at least seven days prior to the cut-off date for enrolment of farmers for the respective season

facts.text: Only farmers whose details are uploaded on the crop insurance portal and whose premium has reached the insurance company in time are covered.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Only those farmers whose data is uploaded on the NCIP and their share of premium has been remitted

facts.text: A farmer without a crop loan can join through the nearest bank branch, a common service centre, an authorised channel partner or an insurance company agent.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: submit the same to nearest bank branch/CSCs or authorized channel partner or insurance intermediary of insurance company

facts.text: For joining without a crop loan the papers are the Aadhaar card copy, the bank passbook, land ownership or tenancy proof, and a sowing certificate or a self declaration of the crop.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: the copy of Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Ownership proof /contract document or any other document defined by the concerned State Government

facts.text: The farmer needs a bank account in the designated bank branch and must give those account details in the application.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: The farmer desiring coverage under crop insurance should open/operate an account in the branch of the designated bank

facts.text: The same piece of land must not be insured twice or through two different agencies.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Non-Loanee farmer should ensure that the crop on the same land is not insured more than once

facts.text: The crop actually standing in the field must be the same crop that was insured, otherwise the claim can be lost.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: if the crop actually sown and insured are different, may lead to forfeiting of claims

facts.text: The scheme covers food crops such as cereals, millets and pulses, oilseeds, and annual commercial or horticultural crops.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Food crops (Cereals, Millets and Pulses)

facts.text: The basic cover protects the standing crop from sowing until harvesting.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: The basic cover under the scheme covers the risk of loss of yield to standing crop (sowing to harvesting)

facts.text: The basic cover applies to yield loss from risks a farmer cannot prevent, such as drought, dry spells, flood and inundation.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: cover yield losses on an area based approach basis due to non-preventable risks like drought, dry spells, flood, inundation

facts.text: The basic cover also lists widespread pest and disease attack, landslide, natural fire from lightning, storm, hailstorm and cyclone.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: wide spread pest and disease attack, landslides, natural fire due to lightening, storm, hailstorm, and cyclone

facts.text: If the state has notified it, there is an add-on cover for when sowing or planting could not happen at all because of not enough rain or bad weather.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Insured area is prevented from sowing/ planting/germination due to deficit rainfall or adverse seasonal/climatic conditions.

facts.text: There is a mid-season cover for bad seasons like floods, long dry spells and severe drought, where the harvest is expected to fall below half of normal.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Loss in case of adverse seasonal conditions during the crop season viz. floods, prolonged dry spells and severe drought

facts.text: Post-harvest cover is available only for up to two weeks from harvesting, for crops left in the field to dry.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Coverage is available only up to a maximum period of two weeks from harvesting

facts.text: The post-harvest cover is for damage by hailstorm, cyclone, cyclonic rain and unseasonal rain to a cut crop lying in the field.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: in the field after harvesting against specific perils of hailstorm, cyclone, cyclonic rains and unseasonal rains

facts.text: For post-harvest cover the crop must have been drying in the field in cut and spread or small bundled condition, up to fourteen days from harvest.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: drying in the field in “cut and spread condition”/small bundled conditions upto a period of 14 days from harvest

facts.text: Localized calamity cover is for hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloud burst and natural fire from lightning that hit single farms rather than the whole area.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: identified localized risks of hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloud burst and natural fire due to lightening affecting isolated farms

facts.text: Inundation means standing water from natural rain or flood water that stays a long time and visibly damages the crop.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: where water stays for a prolonged period and causes visible damage to the crop

facts.text: The add-on covers only exist in a district if the state government has notified them for that season.

citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: This add-on cover will only be available if this cover is notified by the State Government

facts.text: Some states also add a cover for crop damage caused by wild animals, where they have chosen to offer it.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: The States may consider providing add-on coverage for crop loss due to the attack by wild animals

facts.text: The state government fixes the normal harvesting dates for each crop, and the post-harvest cover cannot be used for an event outside that period.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: In the case of any event occurring beyond these dates/this period, this provision shall not be applicable under any circumstances.

facts.text: Losses from war, nuclear risks, deliberate damage, and other things that could have been prevented are not covered.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Losses arising out of war and nuclear risks, malicious damage and other preventable risks shall be excluded.

facts.text: For a localized calamity or a post-harvest loss the farmer must report it, because the damage is checked on that farmer's own field.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020

citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: each district shall designate taluka and district level grievance redressal officer preferably Tehsil/Taluk or District Agriculture/Horticulture Officer

facts.text: If the taluka or district officer does not settle it, the matter goes to the district level grievance committee headed by the Collector.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: This Committee will be headed by the District Magistrate/Collector and the representatives of Farmers, Lead District Manager

facts.text: The government's crop insurance helpline for farmers is the toll-free number one four four four seven, the Krishi Rakshak Portal and Helpline.

citation.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

facts.text: That helpline works day and night, every day of the year, by phone and through the web portal.

citation.title: Operational Guidelines of Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PIB release, 02 December 2025)
citation.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.page: PIB release PRID 2197713, grievance redressal paragraph
citation.quote: KRPHis available 24 X 7 all days in a year through web-portal and voice calls

facts.text: Enrolment for kharif opens from the first of April and for rabi from the first of October, as per the crop calendar.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Start of enrolment of farmers for the season(as per crop calendar) From 1st April From 1st October

facts.text: The guidelines give an indicative last date for joining of the fifth of July for kharif and the fifteenth of December for rabi, but the state's own notification and district crop calendar decide the real date.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: This is indicative only and district wise crop calendar will be the final basis to arrive at cut-off date

facts.text: Prevented sowing cover applies when more than seventy-five per cent of the sown area in a notified unit could not be sown at all.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: affecting crops in more than 75% of the area sown in a notified unit at early stage of sowing

facts.text: If the damaged area is up to a quarter of the cropped area in the unit, each affected farmer's field is surveyed one by one.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Operational Guidelines (Revamped), effective from Kharif 2020
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: When affected area is limited up to 25% of the total cropped area in the notified IU

facts.text: For the kharif twenty twenty-six season in Tamil Nadu, HDFC ERGO is the company authorised to run the scheme in Ranipet and Cuddalore districts, for farmers with and without crop loans.

facts.text: The crops named for that Tamil Nadu kharif season include paddy, black gram, green gram, groundnut, pigeon pea, pearl millet, sesame, bhindi, brinjal, banana, tapioca and turmeric.

facts.text: For that Tamil Nadu kharif season the last dates to join are different for each crop and fall between the middle of July and the middle of September twenty twenty-six.

facts.text: In Tamil Nadu the crop cutting experiments that decide the average yield are done by Assistant Agriculture Officers and supervised by the state statistics department.

citation.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Department of Economics and Statistics, Tamil Nadu
citation.publisher: Department of Economics and Statistics, Government of Tamil Nadu

facts.text: There is a second scheme called the Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme, which pays on measured weather readings instead of on the harvest measured in the field.

citation.title: Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS) - Operational Guidelines (Revised)
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: RWBCIS uses weather parameters as “proxy‟ for crop yields in compensating the cultivators for deemed crop losses.

facts.text: That weather scheme covers deficit or excess rain, unseasonal rain, dry spells, high or low temperature, humidity and wind speed.

citation.title: Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS) - Operational Guidelines (Revised)
citation.publisher: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
citation.quote: Rainfall – Deficit Rainfall, Excess rainfall, Unseasonal Rainfall, Rainy days, Dry-spell, Dry days
